speaker: Mr Desmond Choo
text: asked	the Minister for Finance how does the Government ensure that workers engaged for Government contracts are paid for their work when either the main contractors or the latter's sub-contractors go into liquidation.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
text: The Minister for Manpower has elaborated in his parliamentary response on other forms of assistance available as well as additional measures being put in place to help affected workers.

speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
text: I was wondering whether the Government can consider, under certain circumstances, establishing escrow accounts for certain contracts, so that workers can be protected, especially during difficult economic times.

speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
text: It is not so much a matter of establishing escrow accounts because the scenario painted by the Member is one where you have a main contractor and the employees, and then you have sub-contractors and they have their employees.

speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
text: But it is difficult for the Government to step in and interfere with the contractors' own arrangements of its accounts.
